description: A custom chart inside the built-in panel of the Svelte 5 data grid. When group-by and split-by cannot express the chart, charting.buildSpec hands you the current rows and you return any ChartSpec; here a sankey flow diagram renders in the docked panel, the panel scopes it to the selection and re-runs it on every grid change, so filtering the flow table redraws the ribbons.
keywords: svelte custom chart in grid panel

faq.question: What does buildSpec receive?
faq.answer: The rows currently in scope, the displayed rows or the selected ones, plus the column definitions, and it returns a ChartSpec of any type the chart engine supports.

faq.question: Do the panel's pickers still show?
faq.answer: The Group by and Value pickers are hidden when buildSpec is set, since the spec is yours; the type selector and export remain.

faq.question: When is buildSpec re-run?
faq.answer: On every change to the displayed rows or the selection, so a filter, sort or edit rebuilds the chart without manual wiring.
